Veterans Benefits: Michigan exempts active-duty and retired military pay from individual income tax, offers a disabled-veteran homestead property-tax exemption for qualifying 100% P&T/adapted-housing/IU veterans, and provides veteran property-tax credits, civil-service preference, education assistance for eligible dependents, and hunting/fishing license benefits.

Description: Battle Creek is a southwest Michigan small city known for its cereal-industry history, the Battle Creek VA Medical Center, outdoor access around rivers, parks, and nearby lakes, and a visible defense/government presence through Battle Creek Air National Guard Base and DLA operations at Hart-Dole-Inouye Federal Center. It offers low typical home values and below-average cost of living, but the city crime proxy is high and winters are snowy.
